rag.text:
Test: TC-4015 — Feature area - Goals - CRUD operations - Taking actions after setting objectives to Continue
Priority: Medium | Status: In Review | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-1 Feature area - Objective - CRUD operations
Labels: Sanity, can_be_automated, teamsmile

Steps:
1. Navigate to the Goals module of the boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-4015 Feature area - Objective - CRUD operations - Taking actions after setting objectives to Continue
   Expected: PI1 TC-4015 and PI2 TC-4015 are visible. Two objectives are visible under the PI1 TC-4015
2. Right-click on the objectiveName in subBox
   Data: objectiveName: Objective 1
subBox: PI1 TC-4015
   Expected: Dialog with available operations on objective is visible
3. Select Failed option
   Expected: "What now" confirmation dialog is visible
4. Select Continue option
   Data: objectiveName: Objective 1
subBox: PI1 TC-4015
subBox2: PI2 TC-4015
   Expected: The objectiveName is visible in subBox as failed and in subBox2 as open
5. Right-click on the objectiveName2 in subBox
   Data: objectiveName2: TC4015-1 objective 2
subBox: PI1 TC-4015
   Expected: Dialog with available operations on objective is visible
6. Select Continue option
   Data: objectiveName2: TC4015-1 objective 2
subBox: PI1 TC-4015
subBox2: PI2 TC-4015
   Expected: The objectiveName 2is visible in both subBox and subBox2 as open
7. Zoom in and change timeline to see only the subBox2 timebox
   Data: subBox2: PI2 TC-4015
objectiveName: Objective 1
objectiveName2: TC4015-1 objective 2
   Expected: objectiveName and objectiveName2 are visible under the subBox2
8. Change both objectives PBV and ABV to newPBV and newABV
   Data: newPBV: 6
newABV: 6
   Expected: Both objectives PBV and ABV are changed to newPBV and newABV
9. Change both objectives progress to newProgress
   Data: newProgress: 77%
   Expected: Both objectives progress is changed to newProgress
10. Right click on both objectives and set them as uncommitted
   Expected: Both objectives are set to uncommitted
11. Change both objectives status to newStatus
   Data: newStatus: Completed
   Expected: Both objectives status is changed to newStatus. Progress is 100%.
